handoff_instructions: M3-T12 done. Added resolveEquipmentByReference (packages/core/src/services/equipment-matching.ts), mirroring resolveJobByReference: matches an equipment reference against active equipment in the org by name or alias (case-insensitive substring, either direction); zero matches opens a missing_data ops case, more than one opens a low_confidence ops case listing candidates, exactly one returns the match. Added the Equipment domain type (packages/domain/src/types.ts) and an equipment.read permission (packages/domain/src/permissions.ts, granted to all tenant read roles same as job.read). Added toEquipment row mapper (packages/core/src/rows.ts) and exported the new service from packages/core/src/index.ts. Tests: packages/core/test/equipment-matching.test.ts covers match-by-name, match-by-alias, short-alias (D6), cross-org isolation, inactive equipment being ignored, no-match -> missing_data ops case, and ambiguous-match -> low_confidence ops case with candidates. pnpm format:check/lint/typecheck/test all pass repo-wide. Next: M3-T13 "Fact validator".
